articles.title: Earth
articles.header: Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the only known astronomical object to harbor life.
articles.content: Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the only known astronomical object to harbor life. Earth formed approximately 4.54 billion years ago. It has a diverse environment consisting of oceans, continents, mountains, forests, and deserts. The planet has one natural satellite, the Moon, and an atmosphere primarily composed of nitrogen and oxygen.

articles.title: Solar System
articles.header: The Solar System consists of the Sun and all celestial objects gravitationally bound to it.
articles.content: The Solar System is a gravitational system consisting of the Sun and everything that orbits around it. It contains eight planets, dwarf planets, moons, asteroids, comets, and other smaller objects. The Sun is the central star and contains most of the Solar System's total mass.
